name: blang
description: BLang language support: syntax highlighting plus the blangd language server (diagnostics, go-to-definition, hover)

blang.serverPath.description: Path to the blangd executable. Empty: use build/blangd in the workspace if present, else blangd from PATH.

blang.stdlibPath.description: BLang stdlib directory, sent to blangd as initializationOptions.stdlibPath. Empty: blangd falls back to BLANG_STDLIB_DIR, then the stdlib/ directory next to the blangd binary.

blang.trace.server.description: Trace LSP traffic between VS Code and blangd in the 'BLang Language Server' output channel.
